'''2017 MPC Aaron Kingery LS Old Allies''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Aaron Kingery]] at [[2017 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Aaron Kingery]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 Match Play Championship]]
